properties.name: partition
properties.description: Job partition.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Job ID.

properties.name: completion
properties.description: A job completion is used to complete jobs of various types.

properties.name: calledProcess
properties.description: CalledProcess provides data for the creation of a child process instance.

properties.name: bpmnProcessId
properties.description: BPMN ID of the process to call.

properties.name: correlationKey
properties.description: Optional key, used to correlate the child process instance with a business entity.

properties.name: tags
properties.description: Tags to apply to the child process instance.

items.description: Tag is used to tag entities like process or process instance.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Tag name.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Tag value.

properties.name: variables
properties.description: Variables to set at child process instance scope.

items.description: VariableData represents a named variable, including data.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Data is used to store any data within an engine.

properties.name: encoding
properties.description: Encoding of the value - e.g. json.

properties.name: encrypted
properties.description: Determines if a value is encrypted before it is stored.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value, encoded as a string.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Variable name.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Version of the process to call.

properties.name: errorCode
properties.description: Code of a BPMN error, used to specify or trigger a BPMN error. Applicable when job type is SET_ERROR_CODE or EXECUTE.

properties.name: escalationCode
properties.description: Code of a BPMN escalation, used to specify or trigger a BPMN escalation. Applicable when job type is SET_ESCALATION_CODE or EXECUTE.

properties.name: exclusiveGatewayDecision
properties.description: Evaluated BPMN element ID to continue with after the exclusive gateway. Applicable when job type is EVALUATE_EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY.

properties.name: inclusiveGatewayDecision
properties.description: Evaluated BPMN element IDs to continue with after the inclusive gateway. Applicable when job type is EVALUATE_INCLUSIVE_GATEWAY.

properties.name: messageCorrelationKey
properties.description: Key, used to correlate a message subscription with a message. Applicable when job type is SUBSCRIBE_MESSAGE.

properties.name: messageName
properties.description: Name of the message to subscribe to. Applicable when job type is SUBSCRIBE_MESSAGE.

properties.name: signalName
properties.description: Name of the signal, used to subscribe to or send a signal. Applicable when job type is SUBSCRIBE_SIGNAL or SET_SIGNAL_NAME.

properties.name: timer
properties.description: A timer defines a point in time using a time value, a CRON expression or a duration.

properties.name: time
properties.description: A point in time.

properties.name: timeCycle
properties.description: CRON expression that specifies a cyclic timer.

properties.name: timeDuration
properties.description: Duration based timer that uses the engine's time to calculate a point in time.

properties.description: Variables to set or delete at element instance scope. For a variable deletion, no data must be provided.

properties.name: retryLimit
properties.description: Maximum number of retries. If the retry count is less than the retry limit, a retry job is created. Otherwise, an incident is created.

properties.name: retryTimer
properties.description: Duration until a retry job becomes due. At this point in time a retry job can be locked by a worker.

properties.name: workerId
properties.description: ID of the worker that locked and completed the job.
